violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: The chemical warewashing machine final sanitizing rinse was below the required concentration of 50 ppm at 0 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dischmachine so that food contact surfaces are exposed to sanitizer for the required amount of time and concentration. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food contact surfaces. The PIC stopped using the unit, entered a work order to have it serviced, and will use the 3-compartment sink. Contact your EHS when the unit has been repaired and is working properly.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Handled Single-Service/Use Items Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped knives, forks, or spoons were not stored behind the front counter with the handles up.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the mechanical warewashing machine was not working properly.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Have the unit serviced as soon as possible. Contact your EHS when it is fixed and working properly. Follow-up is required for this violation.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. An unapproved splitter was still installed on the mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS showed the PIC the correct splitter that needed to be installed during the last inspection. If a splitter is needed at the mop sink, it must be an approved model. The one currently installed is not approved and must be removed or replaced. Replace with a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve. Correct within 3 days.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution coming from the dispenser was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution from the dispenser with a concentration of zero ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. Please have the service company service the dispenser so that it dispenses the correct amount of sanitizer. Correct within three days.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the sanitizing solution in the three compartment sink was measured at 500 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quaternary ammonia between 200 and 400 ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. The person in charge emptied half of the solution from the sink and refilled with water to correct. The solution was 200 ppm before the inspection ended. CDI. RASA Mosaic, LLC (Inspection Date: 12/05/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: the handles for two sets of tongs were resting in the cut Romain lettuce and mixed green lettuce at the open greens display refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Please keep the handles of utensils out of food to prevent contact with food. The manager corrected this by moving the tongs. CDI.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. And unapproved splitter was installed on the mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. The EHS showed the person in charge a sample of a correct splitter to be installed. Replace with an approved splitter within three days or disconnect the current splitter.
